objective.name: mailbox_data
objective.description: Defines the content (substance) of a mailbox Matter: the pending and claimed message entries of one continuity.

functional._continuity_id_note: Required. Identifier of the unique continuity owning this mailbox.
functional._entries_note: Required. Collection of mailbox entries referencing durable continuity messages. Physical array order is not canonical; selection order is determined by priority and the referenced message seq.
